themeTitles.L2-situation-numerique-quotidien: Numérique : accéder et rester en contact

semanticAssessments.verdict: Gloss correction justified; no phonetic change.
semanticAssessments.reason: 退货 expresses returning merchandise. A refund may accompany a return in context, but is not the act expressed by the isolated card; 退款 names the refund.

semanticAssessments.verdict: Reject an obligatory onset gloss for 我累了.
semanticAssessments.reason: 我累了 is naturally translated je suis fatigué; sentence-final 了 can make the present changed situation relevant, but does not universally assert that fatigue is just beginning. Context can justify je commence à être fatigué, not an isolated invariant.

semanticAssessments.verdict: No automatic professional classification or upward level move.
semanticAssessments.reason: Water resistance is an ordinary buying criterion for clothes, bags or devices. The short question 这个…吗 is not advanced merely because 防水 is a specific adjective. Scene and preparation decide suitability.

semanticAssessments.verdict: Accessible French gloss useful; not necessarily a professional or advanced card.
semanticAssessments.reason: A buyer may ask about dimming an ordinary lamp. Dimmable is jargon; an accessible explanation is preferable here, without claiming the loanword is never used in French.

semanticAssessments.verdict: Specific textile/paper lexicon; targeted scene, not mechanical grammatical releveling.
semanticAssessments.reason: 克重 calls for a meaning/support appropriate to paper or fabric purchasing. The frame 是多少 is not itself advanced. An optional professional route may fit; neither a new level nor acquisition is established.

semanticAssessments.verdict: Do not make hesitation an invariant of verbal reduplication.
semanticAssessments.reason: Both can politely ask for a brief moment to think; 想想 does not inherently mean more hesitant. Distinguishing usage needs context rather than an invented categorical contrast.

proposedMovesRequiringReview.verdict: Food domain supported; exact commander objective not established by a taste appraisal alone. Add an explicit served-food context or revise the target objective before a move.
State/sleepiness belongs broadly to feelings; Exprimer ce qu’on veut does not directly describe a statement of sleepiness. No automatic title fit.
A sleep report does not specify home; a routines/sleep scene can justify reuse, not an assumed chez soi context.
Driving ability is a mobility question, not finding one’s way. Review under a transport-choice/ability objective instead of a domain-only move.
买 is buying and 这个 leaves the object unspecified; no food context is supplied. Use an explicitly declared purchase scene if retained, not an inferred meal order.
